servers.name: searxng
servers.descriptionPrefix: Search current public web information through the SearxNG MCP server. Use this for internet/news/docs lookups, not for saved memory.

servers.name: engram
servers.descriptionPrefix: Persistent operational memory from Engram. Use these mem_* tools for recalled decisions, session context, preferences, and saved learnings.

servers.name: youtube
servers.descriptionPrefix: YouTube analysis tools. Use these only for YouTube URLs, transcripts, and video metadata.

servers.name: atlas
servers.descriptionPrefix: Atlas knowledge-base tools backed by the Obsidian vault. Use these for persistent notes, project documentation, setup docs, and wikilink relationships stored in Atlas.

servers.name: sonarqube
servers.descriptionPrefix: SonarQube MCP. Use for quality gates, bugs, vulnerabilities, security hotspots, code smells, coverage and duplications. Connects to the local SonarQube instance.
